create.name: Chibs Okereke
create.bio:
Chibs Okereke is a meditation teacher and qualified Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction facilitator, trained through the Center for Mindfulness at the University of Massachusetts Medical School. He came to the work after running his own company and burning out badly; the practices that helped him recover became what he now teaches. He also holds a master's degree in organisational psychology, and he describes his approach, which he calls Mindfulness for Strivers, as a blend of MBSR, positive psychology and gentle work with the breath and the nervous system.

His guided practices are aimed at capable, busy people who find it hard to switch off: vagus-nerve and body-scan meditations, yoga nidra and non-sleep deep rest, short resets for the working day and longer tracks for sleep. He records for the Calm app and posts new meditations on YouTube most weeks. On his own site he runs Tired & Wired, an online membership with a weekly live call, his meditation library and courses on stress, burnout and sleep, and he teaches the eight-week MBSR curriculum live over Zoom. He also leads workshops for companies and writes a weekly letter to his mailing list.

courses.title: Tired & Wired membership
courses.description: His online membership community, with a live group call each week, his full meditation library without adverts, and courses on stress, burnout, sleep and meditation. The eight-week MBSR course also runs inside it.

courses.title: Stress & Burnout Course
courses.description: A course taught live, lesson by lesson, inside the Tired & Wired community on the habits that wear people down, such as perfectionism, people-pleasing and overthinking. Each session pairs a short teaching with a mindfulness or stress-reduction practice, and recordings are kept for anyone who misses a week.
courses.price: Included in Tired & Wired (USD $59 a month)

free_resources.title: Free Vagus Nerve Meditations
free_resources.description: Two free long-form recordings on his site: an overnight practice with breathing, a body scan and soft background noise for falling asleep, and a 40-minute session of gentle breathing and progressive relaxation for unwinding during the day.

free_resources.title: Tired & Wired Toolkit
free_resources.description: A free PDF of simple techniques for winding down and sleeping better, sent by email along with his weekly newsletter.

He brands as a stress and burnout coach and runs corporate workshops; the listing is for his MBSR and meditation teaching. Owner may judge the fit.
